name: keystone-aif
description: AI Factory adapter for Keystone — intent-first workflow for Claude Code. Requires ai-factory >= 2.19 (Requirements Reconciliation gate, #153) and the Claude Code plugin `keystone` (/keystone:start, :grill, :intent, :check, :verify). /aif-plan: level S/M/L, intent as the authoritative source of the reconciliation table (I-n rows), project rules check, Risks, independent intent-plan check before approval. /aif-implement: baseline commit, plan drift fixed in the same commit, literal BLOCKED:, one-line-per-row evidence report. /aif-verify: intent coverage, unrequested work, a checked box is not evidence, rework signal.
